text:
maria: Quick question — PR #3426 updates the rate-limit runbook but the Python SDK snippet still shows retry_on_429=True; tests show we recommend exponential backoff with jitter. Can someone confirm? cc @sam @jordan

sam: Repro'd locally — our python SDK default is still the legacy retry_on_429 behavior. I can update the snippet but want to align with JS too.

jordan: Also found two broken links in the runbook pointing to /guides/context-window. Need to point to /guides/context-limits instead. I'll push a follow-up commit.

docs-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3426 — includes runbook edits. CI: docs-lint passed, snippet-tests failed.

sam: The failing test shows the snippet expects a param named `max_attempts`; our SDK renamed it to `max_retries`. I'll patch the snippet to the current SDK API.

maria: Keep the public snippet showing the recommended pattern (exponential backoff w/ full-jitter). Something concise, e.g.:

```python
from redwood import Client, backoff
c = Client(api_key=...)
resp = c.generate(..., retry_policy=backoff.exponential_jitter(max_retries=5))
```

jordan: For JS snippet I'd mirror that pattern:

```js
const client = new Redwood.Client(...)
await client.generate({...}, { retryPolicy: Redwood.backoff.exponentialJitter(5) })
```

Also add a short comment about preferring 429-aware backoff over immediate fallback to a cheaper model — explain tradeoffs.

sam: On it. One small thing: the runbook has a troubleshooting line suggesting "trim context server-side" — we should add a note recommending client-side prompt trimming first and link to the 'context-trimming-snippets' page.

maria: Good call. Also let's add a short regression test that runs the docs snippet tests to ensure param names match the SDK.

john: FYI release-bot flagged a transient 429 spike in dedicated prod earlier today — might be useful to add a "when to escalate" line to the runbook with the monitored thresholds.

maria: Added that paragraph and a pointer to the SRE playbook. Pushed new commit to the PR.

docs-bot: PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3426/files — includes link fixes + snippet rename.

deploy-bot: CI: snippet-tests now passing on the docs PR. Lint still warns about a Markdown code-fence language tag on a bash snippet.

sam: Fixed the lint; added a small unit test in docs-examples verifying `max_retries` is present in the published snippet. Pushing now.

jordan: I'll approve once tests finish. Also can we add a short entry in the Python SDK changelog noting the rename to `max_retries`? Otherwise customers might be confused by older examples.

maria: Good idea — added an entry to the PR description and linked the changelog.

sam: Tests passed, merging after CI run :shipit:

maria: Thanks team. Follow-up: I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to scan other runbooks for similar legacy snippet names and link inconsistencies.
